recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is needed for FHIR-12670 unless a future work-group decision changes TaskIntent or RequestIntent.
issue_request: FHIR-12670 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU2 technical correction for Task. It reported that Task.intent displayed planned as a valid code even though RequestIntent used the actual code plan; the Jira resolution was auto-approved and recorded the correction as previously applied.
initial_application: Commit 20e489d0d4577bb13967a5310d208b1857c98687 pre-applied FHIR-12670 by changing the historical Task spreadsheet short name from proposed | planned | actionable + to proposal | plan | order +. Later refactoring moved the maintained source into source/task/structuredefinition-Task.xml while preserving the corrected plan wording.
additional_context: Task is active in the current build via source/fhir.ini. Current Task.intent is required-bound to ValueSet/task-intent, TaskIntent includes RequestIntent code plan, and RequestIntent defines plan. Remaining planned strings in Task source are ordinary prose, a separate Task Stage code, mapping context, or generated diagram text rather than Task.intent codes. Zulip and Confluence searches found no human discussion or conflicting work-group evidence.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. The current active source already satisfies the Jira request, so changing source would be redundant or potentially misleading.
